follow_ups.subject: Project Alpha - SWGR: confirm production slot and ship date
follow_ups.body:
Hello,

For SWGR (SWGR-A, SWGR-B, SWGR-C, SWGR-D) on Project Alpha, we need the equipment on site by 2027-08-02. Published lead times for this class and your quoted lead time put the likely arrival around 2027-09-12 (range 2027-08-08 to 2028-07-11).

Please confirm in writing: your reserved production slot, the committed ship date, and any option to expedite.

Thank you.
Procurement, Project Alpha
